prompt:
Look at the HTS (High-Throughput Screening) 384-well plate heatmap image provided. It shows signal intensity across a 16x24 plate. Determine whether the plate shows any systematic error pattern. If so, identify the type of error.

Return a JSON object with two keys:
- 'has_systematic_error' (boolean): true if there is a systematic error
- 'error_type' (string): the type of error if present (e.g., 'edge_effect', 'gradient', 'column_effect')
